population: Official itch.io publisher operating features and selected publicly posted developer records, not representative game sales
unit: purchase event, analytics metric, public-discovery listing, source record, or intellectual property permission as explicitly labeled
period: First-party current rules reviewed October 2026, independent catalog cases released during 2025 and analyzed 2026

audited_existing_tasks.acceptance: Describe recruitment, response bias and missing populations.
audited_existing_tasks.evidence: Public developer case stories are voluntary/self-selected; genre metadata research is a convenience or uncertain-coverage catalog frame; merchant outcome denominators, nonresponders, inactive paid sellers and zero-sale projects are missing.

audited_existing_tasks.acceptance: Describe transaction steps and who collects payment.
audited_existing_tasks.evidence: Buyer page/game minimum, required payment under premium offer, payment provider and platform versus seller merchant-of-record; refunds and payout review differ by mode.

audited_existing_tasks.acceptance: Identify reported conversion and traffic metrics, access and gaps.
audited_existing_tasks.evidence: Page-view, plays, downloads, checkouts, receipts, order events and seller analytics have different access rights and units; paid conversion needs owner-authorized matched event cohorts.

audited_existing_tasks.acceptance: Cite discoverability surfaces, ranking documentation and limits.
audited_existing_tasks.evidence: Public URL, Search & Browse eligibility, ranking, one-time Most Recent opportunity and indexing review are distinct mechanisms with no guaranteed exposure or sale.

audited_existing_tasks.acceptance: Date and source important ranking or policy updates.
audited_existing_tasks.evidence: October 19, 2026 indexing eligibility reform affected previously unindexed pages; historic catalog counters and ranking conditions must retain original effective date.

audited_existing_tasks.acceptance: Document license grants, owner rights and source dates.
audited_existing_tasks.evidence: Uploader warrants redistribution rights, platform receives defined hosting/publicity license, but source code, media, fonts and third-party assets each have independent original conditions; no automatic cross-store media clearance.

exclusion_and_access: Distinct seller page, paid transaction, buyer and game file units must never be conflated.
First-party public policy language is not a current approved seller account or government licensing determination.
Purchase counts and view counts are event totals, not deduplicated humans.
Indexing reform unblocked old projects and should not be counted as newly profitable commercial titles.
Historical source text can be linked and summarized, not automatically republished or sold.
Source-derived uncertainty does not mean actual market success or failure is zero.
